# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `telnyx` MCP server pointing at Telnyx's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://api.telnyx.com/v2/ai/mcp`).
- API documentation tools work without signing in. Account tools use Telnyx OAuth.
- Logo: the Telnyx GitHub organization avatar.
